changes: Hold SCENE and turn a knob: that parameter is locked in the active scene, without leaving the page.
Hold SCENE and press a knob to remove that scene lock.
SCENE held and let go with no knob opens scene edit as before, now on the release.
With no scene active a popup says NO ACTIVE SCENE.
Takes less of the RAM all modules share, so more modules fit beside it. No change to how it works or sounds.
Hold FIX, SAMPLER or LFO for about half a second just to look at the amounts: letting go then does nothing.
A quick tap still toggles fixed velocity, opens the recorder or opens the LFO page.
With LFO held, a MIDI turn passed to stock's locker by a module now sets the LFO's depth too, not only the Rytm's knobs.
Hold LFO and turn a knob: that parameter becomes the LFO's destination; keep turning to set the depth.
With LFO held, pressing the destination's knob sets the depth back to 0.
An LFO tap opens the LFO page on the release, as FIX now toggles on the release.
Other mods that follow the page keys now see that LFO tap too.
First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: hold FIX and turn a knob to link that parameter to velocity.
Hold SAMPLER and turn a knob to link it to aftertouch.
While held, linked knobs show their amounts like performance locks.
Uses the sound's own four velocity and four aftertouch slots, so links save with the kit.
A FIX tap now toggles fixed velocity when you let go.
